# Avenue Shabu: Growth in Repeat Guests

This MSDM culminating experience project connects Toast/POS data, customer experience research, CRM, loyalty, email/SMS campaigns, and retention measurement.

The goal is to identify practical interventions that increase repeat-visit frequency and customer value while considering campaign and reward costs.
